title: Find All Possible Recipes from Given Supplies
goal: Find all recipes that can eventually be prepared from the initial supplies.
strategy: Ingredients become available events. Track each recipe unresolved count and reverse dependencies; when its count reaches zero, that recipe becomes a new available ingredient.

phasePurposes.start: Find all recipes that can eventually be prepared from the initial supplies.

phasePurposes.done: Find all recipes that can eventually be prepared from the initial supplies.

edgeCases: A dependency cycle cannot create its own starting ingredient
A missing raw ingredient blocks only its dependent branch
One supplied ingredient unlocks several recipes
inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.
